If you’re looking for aggregate statistics on member attendance (e.g., total visits, average visits per member, peak visiting days), I’d recommend checking the museum’s internal analytics portal or contacting their Membership Services team.  

Alternatively, if you only care about identifying which individual members were the most active during that time frame, I can run a query to find the single visitor with the highest visit count between January 1 and December 31 of last year. Let me know if that would help!
